```{r setup}
library(RieszCML)

library(tibble)

#---------------------------------------------
# Simulate a simple longitudinal DGP
#---------------------------------------------
sim_dgp <- function(n) {
  L1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

  # baseline treatment
  A1 <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = plogis(-0.2 + 1.0 * L1))

  # time-varying confounder affected by A1
  U2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  L2 <- 0.5 + 0.7 * L1 + 2.0 * A1 + U2

  # second treatment
  A2 <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = plogis(-0.3 + 0.6 * A1 + 1.2 * L2))

  # bounded outcome in (0,1), convenient for logistic TMLE
  Y <- plogis(-0.5 + 0.3 * L1 + 0.8 * L2 + 1.0 * A2)

  tibble(
    L1 = L1,
    A1 = A1,
    L2 = L2,
    A2 = A2,
    Y = Y
  )
}

set.seed(1)
df <- sim_dgp(n = 5000)

#---------------------------------------------
# Stage 1 RieszCurve:
#   parameter is E[Y | L1, A1] under intervention A2 = 1
#---------------------------------------------
rc1 <- RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = function(data) {
    # regression for Y given current history
    m_fit <- glm(Y ~ L1 + A1 + L2 + A2,
                 family = gaussian(),
                 data = data)

    data_A2eq1 <- data
    data_A2eq1$A2 <- 1

    # treatment mechanism for A2
    g_fit <- glm(A2 ~ L1 + A1 + L2,
                 family = binomial(),
                 data = data)

    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, newdata = data, type = "response"),
      m1 = predict(m_fit, newdata = data_A2eq1, type = "response"),
      g = predict(g_fit, newdata = data, type = "response")
    )
  },
  h = ~ m1,
  f = ~ m,
  alpha = ~ A2 / g,
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (Y - f),
  targeting_steps = list(m = list(), m1 = list(A2 = 1))
)

#---------------------------------------------
# Stage 2 RieszCurve:
#   parameter is E[h[j=1] | L1] under intervention A1 = 1
#---------------------------------------------
rc2 <- RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = function(data) {
    m_fit <- glm(`h[j=1]` ~ L1 + A1,
                 family = gaussian(),
                 data = data)

    data_A1eq1 <- data
    data_A1eq1$A1 <- 1

    g_fit <- glm(A1 ~ L1,
                 family = binomial(),
                 data = data)

    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, newdata = data, type = "response"),
      m1 = predict(m_fit, newdata = data_A1eq1, type = "response"),
      g = predict(g_fit, newdata = data, type = "response")
    )
  },
  h = ~ m1,
  f = ~ m,
  alpha = ~ A1 / g,
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (`h[j=1]` - f),
  targeting_steps = list(m = list(), m1 = list(A1 = 1))
)

#---------------------------------------------
# Compose the two stages
#---------------------------------------------
rc_composed <- ComposedRieszCurve$new(
  rc_list = list(rc1, rc2)
)

#---------------------------------------------
# One-step estimate using composed object
#---------------------------------------------
est_onestep <- riesz_estimate(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_composed
)

est_onestep
```


```{r}
#---------------------------------------------
# TMLE using the composed object
#---------------------------------------------
est_tmle <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_composed,
  fluctuation_type = "logistic",
  bounds = c(0, 1),
  outcome_col = "Y"
)

est_tmle
```
